meta_description: Check EloBetter's Privacy Policy. Learn how we handle information, cookie usage, and the security of our guide to climb the ranks.
meta_keywords: elobetter privacy, privacy policy, elobetter security, elo guide, cookie
title: Privacy Policy
p1: At EloBetter, privacy is not just a legal term; it is the foundation of our content creation and every tool. This policy clearly explains how information is processed.
p2: Most of the site operates on an informational basis. You can read the guide, watch videos, and check elo tips completely anonymously, without the need to provide personal data to access public content.
p3: We collect only the bare minimum necessary to keep the platform functional and secure:
li_log_text: Basic information such as IP address, browser type, and visited pages is received for security purposes, abuse prevention, and traffic analysis.
li_cookie_text: The site uses cookies to save browsing preferences (such as dark mode) and to understand which guide or character is the most searched for, helping to improve the content.
h2_integration: 3. Integration and Third-Party Data (Riot Games, Steam, etc.)
note_text: The profile lookup tool (such as checking current elo and statistics) uses public data consumed directly from the game's official API.
p4: The guide may contain links to external sites, streamer channels, video platforms, or social networks. The site has no control over the content or privacy practices of third parties and assumes no responsibility for their respective policies.
p5: The site does not sell or share data with third parties. In case of contact via email or form for suggestions or questions, the data will be used exclusively to respond to the request and will be deleted after service.
p6: By using EloBetter, the user agrees to the practices described on this page. This policy may be updated occasionally to reflect improvements in the guide.
